title: Doing Missions When Dying Is Gain - Part 1
description: In this sermon, the preacher emphasizes the importance of fulfilling the promise of preaching the gospel throughout the whole world as a testimony to all nations. He clarifies that "nations" refers to people groups rather than political states. The preacher believes that this mission is certain to be accomplished because Jesus never lies and his word will never pass away. He also highlights the price of suffering that comes with this mission, but assures that the prize of satisfying the glory of God is worth it. The preacher encourages the audience to embrace this mission and allow God to bring about transformation in their lives.
